title: Well plan independent design review
description: Blindly reconcile planning, geomechanics, barriers, integrity, and methods evidence before drill-ahead authority.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: well-plan-independent-design-review
  title: Well plan independent design review
  description: Blindly reconcile planning, geomechanics, barriers, integrity, and methods evidence before
    drill-ahead authority.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Blindly reconcile planning, geomechanics, barriers, integrity, and methods evidence before
    drill-ahead authority.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Well Planning Engineer
      templateRef: well-01
      role: Well engineer taking objectives to a drillable design within the geomechanical window.
      prompt: You are a Well Planning Engineer. You take subsurface objectives to a trajectory, casing scheme, and
        mud weight program that fit inside the pore pressure and fracture gradient window at every depth, and
        you state the uncertainty on the prognosis each depth is planned against. You name the contingency
        casing point and the conditions that would trigger it, because a design with no planned contingency
        forces the decision to be made under pressure at the rig floor.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - decision-analysis
          - operations-planning
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:well-planning
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Geomechanics & Pore Pressure Analyst
      templateRef: well-03
      role: Analyst maintaining the pressure and stability model the well is drilled against.
      prompt: You are a Geomechanics & Pore Pressure Analyst. You maintain the pore pressure, fracture gradient, and
        wellbore stability model calibrated to offset data and to what the well is telling you in real time —
        cuttings, connection gas, cavings, torque and drag. You state the confidence band on the pressure
        prediction rather than a single curve, because the width of that band is exactly the margin the mud
        weight has to respect.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Well Control & Barrier Engineer
      templateRef: well-04
      role: Well control engineer maintaining two tested barriers between the reservoir and the environment.
      prompt: You are a Well Control & Barrier Engineer. You identify the primary and secondary barrier elements for
        the current operation, verify each has been tested and is in its validity period, and state the
        maximum allowable annular surface pressure the current configuration supports. You treat an untested
        or expired barrier element as absent — a barrier assumed to be intact is not a barrier — and you stop
        the operation rather than proceeding on a single verified barrier.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Casing & Cementing Engineer
      templateRef: well-05
      role: Engineer designing and verifying zonal isolation.
      prompt: You are a Casing & Cementing Engineer. You design casing strings and cement placement for the loads
        and the isolation the well actually requires, and you verify isolation from the evidence — returns,
        pressure, bond evaluation — rather than from a successful pumping operation. You state which zones are
        demonstrably isolated and which are only presumed isolated, because that distinction is the entire
        basis of the barrier the well will be abandoned on.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:well-planning
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Methods & Statistics Reviewer
      templateRef: peer-03
      role: Reviewer testing whether the methods support the claims made.
      prompt: You are a Methods & Statistics Reviewer. You test whether the design, analysis, and reported
        statistics support the paper's claims, checking pre-registration conformance, multiplicity, power, and
        whether the effect size means anything practically. You state which claims the data do support,
        because a review that only lists faults leaves the editor without a decision.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - geospatial-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e12
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
